summary: A single-piece firmware built around Chopin's Etude Op. 10 No. 1: it plays the full piece on a sampled Steinway and lets you shape, practise, transpose and re-voice it.
features: Performance controls for rubato, dynamics, accents and pedal style
Practice tools: slow-down, bar loops, click, play one hand yourself
"WAIT" mode waits for the right note and charts progress per bar
Change key, mode or bass; historical tunings and pitch standards
Nine sounds; MIDI out with each hand on its own channel
Stores data in Felucca's first two song slots; supports newer-chipset units
